sentences.en: Riot police fired tear gas and water cannons at demonstrators.
sentences.zh: 警察向示威者发射了催泪弹和水炮。

sentences.en: It is the rope which holds the cannon in place.
sentences.zh: 这是用来固定大炮的绳索。

sentences.en: We began to pound the enemy positions with cannon fire.
sentences.zh: 我们开始用大炮轰击敌方阵地。

senses.zh: 大炮；加农炮；榴弹炮；机关炮
